notes: Stories 7-9 may only be started after all v1 stories are Completed. Story 7 depends on 4 and 5 (account commands and api call must exist for scope NeedsReauth to be testable end-to-end). Story 8 (trace) depends on 5 because ApiClient must exist to integrate trace auto-append. Story 6 (util) is independent of 3-5 and can be done in parallel with stories 3-5 if desired — depends only on 2 (output contract). Stories 10-12 implement the browser OAuth redirect login flow (account login command) — see .ai/plans/account-login-browser-flow.md. Story 10 can be started as soon as Story 2 is complete (only needs ZapiCliException + ErrorCodes). Story 11 requires Story 4 (AccountService) AND Story 10. Story 12 requires Story 11 only.
